summary: Lycoming County bald lookout site used circa 1917 and no longer standing; sources disagree on whether a tower was built. No source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Register says no longer standing; sources differ on whether a tower was ever built

events.note: Bald lookout site used circa 1917 (register and statewide list); regional listing says an observation point established prior to 1918
Registered on the Former Fire Lookout Sites register on September 16, 2008

evidence.supports: Bald tower used circa 1917, no longer standing
evidence.quote: This bald tower was used circa 1917 and is no longer standing.

evidence.supports: No coordinates available on the register
Regional listing: unimproved bald top observation point established before 1918
evidence.quote: An unimproved bald top observation point established prior to 1918.

evidence.supports: Statewide entry: bald, no build year, not standing, used circa 1917
evidence.quote: Elk Knob Lycoming Bald U/A Not Standing Used circa 1917

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register calls it a 'bald tower'; the regional listing calls it an unimproved bald top observation point; the statewide list codes it as bald with no build year. The story reports the wording of each source and does not state that a structure was built.

sources.title: Elk Knob Tower Site
sources.publisher: Former Fire Lookout Sites register, Forest Fire Lookout Association

sources.title: Pennsylvania Fire Lookouts, State Listing Page

notes_for_editor: The record's map point (41.46429, -77.06481, marked approximate) comes from a GNIS name match to 'Elk Knob', not from any lookout source; the register says no coordinates are available. Treat the point as unverified, or remove it, before publishing. The record's elevation is blank and no source gives one. The register ('bald tower') and the regional listing ('unimproved bald top observation point') disagree on whether anything was built, so the kind should stay unknown until a source settles it. No photo was found.
